implementation_flow: navigate increments routeEpoch and schoolEpoch, records the current epoch, then clears the prior shared journey.loading flag.
The route is replaced and its normal route-specific read starts; a directory load or school lookup sets journey.loading=true for its own pending work.
Older directory/lookup completions retain existing epoch checks and return before writing state when stale, so they cannot clear a newer read's loading flag.
A current read completes under its existing code path and clears the flag it owns.
